title: Chicken or Turkey Salad with Light Mayonnaise Dressing

content.title: About
content.content: Chicken or turkey salad made with a light mayonnaise‑type dressing is a ready‑to‑eat dish that includes cooked poultry, fresh vegetables (usually lettuce, tomato, cucumber) and a low‑fat creamy sauce. It is packaged for convenience and can be eaten straight from the container.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chicken and turkey provide lean, high‑quality protein that is easy to digest.
Light mayonnaise dressing typically contains fewer calories and less fat than regular mayonnaise.
Salads are often vacuum‑packed, extending shelf life without the need for added preservatives.
Seasonings such as dill, parsley or garlic are commonly added for extra flavor.
The product is popular in office cafeterias and as a quick snack.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Poultry meat supplies essential amino acids needed for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: The light dressing reduces saturated fat intake, making the salad suitable for heart‑healthy diets.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Chicken and turkey are rich in B3 (niacin) and B6, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The salad provides potassium, phosphorus and iron, important for cardiovascular and blood health.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Vegetables add fiber that helps maintain regular digestion.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken or turkey.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Light dressings often contain added salt; people monitoring sodium should watch portion size.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep the salad refrigerated and consume within 2‑3 days.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Certain versions may contain preservatives such as sorbate, which can cause sensitivity in some people.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The salad is ready to eat straight from the package. For extra freshness you can add more raw vegetables, herbs, or a squeeze of lemon. It pairs well with whole‑grain bread or a wrap.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C. Do not freeze. After opening, consume within 2‑3 days and discard if it develops an off odor or discoloration.
